about: Families welcome back the souls of the dead with altars of marigolds, candles and sugar skulls (UNESCO intangible heritage).

about: Held on the two Mondays after 16 July, delegations from Oaxaca’s regions perform their traditional dances and share their foods.

about: On the night of 15 September the president repeats the 1810 "Cry of Dolores" from the National Palace balcony, followed by a parade on the 16th.
15 Eylül gecesi devlet başkanı Ulusal Saray’ın balkonundan 1810’daki “Dolores Çığlığı”nı tekrarlar; 16’sında askeri geçit yapılır.
In der Nacht zum 16. September wiederholt der Präsident vom Balkon des Nationalpalasts den „Schrei von Dolores“ von 1810; am 16. folgt eine Parade.
La noche del 15 de septiembre el presidente repite el Grito de Dolores de 1810 desde el balcón del Palacio Nacional; el 16 hay desfile.
